submission.justification: Based on comprehensive simulation analysis, Radiator-R2 at 3 cm thickness is recommended for the RICH detector. While Radiator-R1 achieves the highest pion/kaon separation performance (4.531σ at 4 cm), it fails to meet the lifetime requirements critical for long-term detector operation. Among the two radiators that pass lifetime requirements (R2 and R3), Radiator-R2 delivers superior performance with 3.724σ separation at 3 cm thickness, representing a 23.4% performance advantage over R3 (3.018σ at 2 cm). This configuration provides the optimal balance between particle identification capability and detector longevity, ensuring robust hadron separation throughout the experiment's operational lifetime.

requirements.evidence: Radiator-R2 at 3 cm achieves 3.724σ separation, the best performance among radiators meeting all constraints. While R1 theoretically achieves higher separation (4.531σ), it is disqualified by lifetime requirements.

Recommended thickness of 3 cm falls within the specified range of 1-6 cm.
